title: Two Children Jackie & Linda in Deep Snow, 1950s Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1950s black and white square snapshot capturing two small children, named Jackie and Linda on the reverse side, standing knee-deep in freshly fallen snow outside the exterior wall of a clapboard home. They are bundled up warmly in hooded winter coats, mittened hands, and heavy trousers, looking directly into the camera lens with subtle expressions. The deckle-edged photograph reflects mid-20th-century family life in snowy northern regions.
